title: What Nvidia’s Interim CEO, Colette Kress, Said to Employees After Jensen Huang’s Resignation
summary: At an all-hands meeting with employees, Colette Kress sought to put the indiscretions of Nvidia’s co-founder, Jensen Huang, behind them.
